# Calendar Email Reminders Build Brief
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent) on behalf of Agno JF

## Outcome

Administrators can configure three event email reminders during event creation and editing. The application sends enabled reminders to active, approved, email-verified participants and administrators.

## In Scope

- 3-day, 1-day, and 15-minute reminders.
- All three reminders enabled by default.
- Individual reminder controls during event create and edit.
- Configured-timezone display and UTC scheduling.
- Queue delivery, retries, duplicate prevention, and event-change handling.
- Local automated and Mailpit verification.

## Out Of Scope

- Recurring events.
- Attendee invitations or RSVP management.
- External Google or Outlook calendar synchronization.
- Per-user reminder preferences.

## Acceptance Result

Local implementation and automated checks must pass. Staging and launch acceptance remain blocked until real mail transport, queue processing, minute scheduling, recipient filtering, and delivery monitoring are proven.
